Fruit Crepe
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 30, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




2 cups Bisquick
1 1/2 cups milk
1/4 cup sugar
3 tablespoons cinnamon
3 eggs

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients thoroughly in medium bowl. Fry in large frying pan (greased). Batter should be 6 to 8 inches in diameter. Cook on medium heat until golden brown. Flip then add fruit. Apple, cherry, blueberries, etc. Topping Cool Whip.
